data.name: Green Man Char
data.description: Green Man Char is the product brand of Cyclic Carbon Pty Ltd, an Australian biochar producer operating at the Yarra Ranges biochar facility in Victoria using Earth Systems' CharMaker continuous pyrolysis technology to convert local woody waste into biochar and wood vinegar. The company sells biochar, activated charcoal, wood vinegar and frass for agricultural and horticultural applications, and the facility won the 2025 LGPro VIC Award for Environmental Sustainability.
